```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(stargazer)
library(lmtest)
library(data.table)
library(sandwich)
```
  

```{r}
save_path_data <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/day_ahead/outputs/esp"
setwd(save_path_data)
price_indispo_merge <- read_parquet("price_indispo_merge_esp.parquet")
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>%
  fill(spot_gas, .direction = "up") %>% 
  rename(renewable_day_ahead_forecast = day_ahead_forecast)



```

```{r}

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(price_indispo_merge)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(price_indispo_merge))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "renewable_day_ahead_forecast",  "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables"
    
    )
price_indispo_merge[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(price_indispo_merge[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
#
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity = Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity - Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
              temperature_mismatch = temperature_demand - temperature_supply ,
         gen_tot = gen_tot - gen_tot_da
         ) 

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[complete.cases(price_indispo_merge),]

price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge[!rowSums(sapply(price_indispo_merge, is.infinite)), ]

price_indispo_merge$weekday <- weekdays(price_indispo_merge$delivery_date)
price_indispo_merge$creneau <- hour(price_indispo_merge$datetime)


#design partie temperature

cold_months <- c(1, 2, 11, 12)
hot_months <- c(6, 7, 8, 9)

# "temperature_2m_hydro"                      
# [51] "temperature_2m_nuclear"                    
# [52] "temperature_2m_thermal"
price_indispo_merge <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  mutate(cold_excess_demand = -ifelse(temperature_demand <= 10, 
                                          temperature_demand, 0),
         heat_excess_demand = ifelse(temperature_demand >= 20,
                                         temperature_demand, 0),
         cold_excess_supply = -ifelse(temperature_supply <= 10, 
                                          temperature_supply, 0),
         heat_excess_supply = ifelse(temperature_supply >= 20,
                                         temperature_supply, 0),
         cold_excess_hydro = -ifelse(temperature_2m_hydro <= 10, 
                                          temperature_2m_hydro, 0),
         heat_excess_hydro = ifelse(temperature_2m_hydro >= 20,
                                         temperature_2m_hydro, 0),
         cold_excess_nuclear = -ifelse(temperature_2m_nuclear <= 10, 
                                          temperature_2m_nuclear, 0),
         heat_excess_nuclear = ifelse(temperature_2m_nuclear >= 20,
                                         temperature_2m_nuclear, 0),
         cold_excess_thermal = -ifelse(temperature_2m_thermal <= 10, 
                                          temperature_2m_thermal, 0),
         heat_excess_thermal = ifelse(temperature_2m_thermal >= 20,
                                         temperature_2m_thermal, 0),
         cold_excess_mismatch = ifelse(month %in% cold_months,
                                       temperature_supply - temperature_demand, 0),
         heat_excess_mismatch = ifelse(month %in% hot_months,
                                       temperature_demand - temperature_supply, 0),
         
         temp_excess_demand = cold_excess_demand + heat_excess_demand,
         temp_excess_supply = cold_excess_supply + heat_excess_demand,
         temp_excess_mismatch = cold_excess_mismatch + heat_excess_mismatch,
         temp_excess_hydro = cold_excess_hydro + heat_excess_hydro,
         temp_excess_nuclear = cold_excess_nuclear + heat_excess_nuclear,
         temp_excess_thermal = cold_excess_thermal + heat_excess_thermal,
         
         
  )
colnames(price_indispo_merge)

```

On suggère deux hypothèses, soit différence en niveau sur longue période, soit différence immédiate sur des conditions quasi similaires lors de l'activation d'une indispo à deux créneaux proches.

Attention le fait d'avoir pris des heures arrondies à l'heure plien la plus proche peut fausser
les résultats.

```{r}

m_rf_temp <- lm(
  log(price) ~  temperature_demand + temperature_supply + 
    #temperature_mismatch +
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
    gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso + renewable_day_ahead_forecast   + 
    thermal_tot + hydro_tot+ nuclear+
    spot_gas + 
    unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    
    precipitation_demand + precipitation_supply +
    relative_humidity_demand + relative_humidity_supply+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= price_indispo_merge)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_temp , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_temp <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))



m_rf_temp_excess <- lm(
  log(price) ~  
    temp_excess_demand + temp_excess_supply + 
    #temp_excess_mismatch+
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
    gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso + renewable_day_ahead_forecast   + spot_gas + 
    thermal_tot + hydro_tot+ nuclear+
    unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    precipitation_demand + precipitation_supply +
    relative_humidity_demand + relative_humidity_supply+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= price_indispo_merge)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_temp_excess , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_temp_excess<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_rf_heat_cold_excess <- lm(
  log(price) ~  
    heat_excess_demand + cold_excess_demand + 
    heat_excess_supply+ cold_excess_supply+
    #heat_excess_mismatch+ cold_excess_mismatch+
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
    gen_tot_da + gen_tot +  gen_tot_da_conso + renewable_day_ahead_forecast   + spot_gas + 
    thermal_tot + hydro_tot+ nuclear+
    unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    precipitation_demand + precipitation_supply +
    relative_humidity_demand + relative_humidity_supply+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= price_indispo_merge)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_heat_cold_excess , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_heat_cold_excess <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))




```




```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer(  m_rf_temp, m_rf_temp_excess,  m_rf_heat_cold_excess,
    type = "html",
    se = list( cl_se_rf_temp, cl_se_rf_temp_excess, cl_se_rf_heat_cold_excess),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c(  "Temperature", "Heat/Cold Excess", "Temperature Excess"),
    keep = c("Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
              "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Planned.Limiting.Capacity",
    "Published.Limiting.Capacity", "Unpublished.Limiting.Capacity", "UnPublished.Limiting.Capacity",
      "gen_tot",
             "renewable_day_ahead_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables", "temp_excess_supply", "temp_excess_mismatch",
    "heat_excess_supply", "cold_excess_supply", "heat_excess_mismatch",  "cold_excess_mismatch", 
    "temperature_mismatch", "temperature_supply", "temperature_demand", "temp_excess_demand",
    "precipitation_supply", "precipitation_demand",
    "relative_humidity_supply", "relative_humidity_demand",
     "heat_excess_demand","cold_excess_demand")
)
 
```

On essaye maintenant de décomposer par type d'énergie

```{r}
excess_headers <- c("heat_excess_hydro" , "cold_excess_hydro",
   "heat_excess_nuclear" , "cold_excess_nuclear",
    "heat_excess_thermal" ,"cold_excess_thermal",
    "heat_excess_mismatch", "cold_excess_mismatch",
   "temp_excess_hydro" , "temp_excess_nuclear",
   "temp_excess_thermal" , "temp_excess_mismatch","temperature_demand", "temp_excess_demand","heat_excess_demand","cold_excess_demand",
   "temperature_2m_hydro", "temperature_2m_nuclear","temperature_2m_thermal"
   )

m_rf_type <- lm(
  log(price) ~  temperature_demand + temperature_2m_hydro + temperature_2m_nuclear + temperature_2m_thermal+
    thermal_tot + hydro_tot+ nuclear+ renewable_day_ahead_forecast   +

    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
    spot_gas +

# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_type , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_type <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_rf_type_cold_heat <- lm(

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_type_cold_heat , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
```
